summary.name: speaking.app
summary.one_liner: speaking.app is an AI speech practice tool that gives feedback on your spoken delivery for pitches, interviews, speeches, and conversations.
use_cases: Rehearsing a startup pitch to investors
Preparing a wedding or event speech
summary.what_it_does: The page describes practicing out loud and receiving feedback on fillers, pauses, emphasis, pacing, flat spots, rising endings, and overall structure. A tighter version of the message is offered, prompting the user to supply missing content. A Learn section offers short lessons, examples, and quizzes on speaking structures and rhetorical techniques such as Past, Present, Future, STAR, and Anaphora. A startup pitch section breaks a pitch into parts, such as the Ask, for separate practice with feedback. A library analyzes publicly available speeches for structure, pacing, and rhetoric.
notable: Feedback on delivery of your own spoken practice, including pacing, pauses, and emphasis
Startup pitch practice broken into parts such as the Ask
Library of public speeches analyzed for structure and rhetoric
caveats: Users must be 16 or older to sign up, per the page's sign-up notice
Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page; the listing tags it freemium
